records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: 涼しいっちゃ涼しいけど……
records.en_original: I do feel a slight breeze, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I do feel a slight breeze, but...
records.en: I do feel a slight breeze, but...

records.jp: なに？　あなたここに涼みにきたの？
records.en_original: What? Did you come here to cool off?
records.en_auxiliary: What? Did you come here to cool off?
records.en: What? Did you come here to cool off?

records.jp: だって扇風機みたいなもんじゃん
records.en_original: Well, it looks like a giant fan, doesn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, it looks like a giant fan, doesn't it?
records.en: Well, it looks like a giant fan, doesn't it?

records.jp: 仕組み真逆なんだけど
records.en_original: It is the exact opposite of a fan.
records.en_auxiliary: It is the exact opposite of a fan.
records.en: It is the exact opposite of a fan.

records.jp: でもこの涼しさはこれのおかげっていうより、<CR>向こうから吹いてくる風のおかげかな
records.en_original: But I get the feeling that the wind is what's cooling me down, not this thing.
records.en_auxiliary: But I get the feeling that the wind is what's cooling me down, not this thing.
records.en: But I get the feeling that the wind is what's<CR>cooling me down, not this thing.

records.jp: それはそうでしょ。<CR>風通しが良い場所に立てなきゃ意味ない
records.en_original: That's the whole point. There'd be no use building one here if there wasn't any wind.
records.en_auxiliary: That's the whole point. There'd be no use building one here if there wasn't any wind.
records.en: That's the whole point.<CR>There'd be no use building one here if there wasn't any wind.

records.jp: ま、どっちでもいいや。気持ちよければそれで
records.en_original: Well, either way, it sure feels good.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, either way, it sure feels good.
records.en: Well, either way, it sure feels good.

records.jp: ……まぁ、それもそうね
records.en_original: ...Well, you're right about that.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Well, you're right about that.
records.en: ...Well, you're right about that.

records.jp: 意外とゆっくり回るんだなって
records.en_original: It's slower than I imagined.
records.en_auxiliary: It's slower than I imagined.
records.en: It's slower than I imagined.

records.jp: なんか、涼しい顔して立ってるから、<CR>おもちゃの風車みたいな感じで回ってると思ってた
records.en_original: I always thought it'd be spinning like a pinwheel.
records.en_auxiliary: I always thought it'd be spinning like a pinwheel.
records.en: It stands there looking so calm,<CR>so I imagined it spinning like a toy pinwheel.

records.jp: この大きさで、風車のと同じ速さで回ってたら<CR>怖いでしょ
records.en_original: Something this big spinning that fast would be terrifying.
records.en_auxiliary: Something this big spinning that fast would be terrifying.
records.en: If something this large spun at the same speed as a pinwheel,<CR>it would be terrifying.

records.jp: あはは、たしかに。そのまま飛んでいきそう
records.en_original: Haha, you're right. It would probably fly away.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha, you're right. It would probably fly away.
records.en: Haha, you're right. It would probably fly away.

records.jp: ……星崎さんと話してると飽きないよ
records.en_original: I never get bored talking to you, Hoshizaki...
records.en_auxiliary: I never get bored talking to you, Hoshizaki...
records.en: I never get bored talking to you, Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: ところで、伶那さんはこれの見た目は怖くないの？
records.en_original: You don't think it looks scary, Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't think it looks scary, Rena?
records.en: You don't think it looks scary, Rena-san?

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: Why would I?
records.en_auxiliary: Why would I?
records.en: Why would I?

records.jp: 前に苦手って言ってなかった？<CR>こういう無機物っぽいの
records.en_original: I thought you said you didn't like things that move on their own.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you said you didn't like things that move on their own.
records.en: Didn't you say before that you didn't like<CR>this kind of inorganic-looking thing?

records.jp: 別に。このデザインには理由があるから
records.en_original: Not really. There's a reason to the design.
records.en_auxiliary: Not really. There's a reason to the design.
records.en: Not really. There's a reason to the design.

records.jp: 理由？
records.en_original: A reason?
records.en_auxiliary: A reason?
records.en: A reason?

records.jp: まずこの羽根の部分だけど、<CR>ここは「ブレード」といって……
records.en_original: So the parts that spin are called "blades"...
records.en_auxiliary: So the parts that spin are called "blades"...
records.en: First, these wing-like parts<CR>are called “blades”...

records.jp: ここが回転す……て動力が……に伝わると……
records.en_original: When they rotate...power, which is...and transmitted to...
records.en_auxiliary: When they rotate...power, which is...and transmitted to...
records.en: When they rotate...power, which is...and transmitted to...

records.jp: （めっちゃ説明してくれてるけど、<CR>羽根の音で聞こえない）
records.en_original: (She's trying really hard to explain, but I can't hear anything over the noise of the blades.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's trying really hard to explain, but I can't hear anything over the noise of the blades.)
records.en: (She's explaining it in great detail,<CR>but I can't hear her over the blades.)

records.jp: ……っていう仕組みなの。<CR>だからこのデザインになったわけ。わかった？
records.en_original: ...which is how it generates electricity. That's why it looks like that. Does that make sense?
records.en_auxiliary: ...which is how it generates electricity. That's why it looks like that. Does that make sense?
records.en: ...which is how it generates electricity.<CR>That's why it looks like that. Does that make sense?

records.jp: わかった！
records.en_original: Yup!
records.en_auxiliary: Yup!
records.en: Yup!

records.jp: 元気に返事されると逆に不安になるんだけど
records.en_original: For some reason, your enthusiasm doesn't impart confidence.
records.en_auxiliary: For some reason, your enthusiasm doesn't impart confidence.
records.en: For some reason, your enthusiasm doesn't impart confidence.

records.jp: 風に吹かれてぐるぐるってなって、<CR>力がこう、みなぎって発電するんだよね
records.en_original: The wind makes it go round and round, and it, y'know, stores up power, which becomes electricity.
records.en_auxiliary: The wind makes it go round and round, and it, y'know, stores up power, which becomes electricity.
records.en: The wind makes it spin round and round,<CR>the power wells up, and it generates electricity, right?

records.jp: で、そうした時に、この形が一番効率が良いんでしょ？
records.en_original: And...this shape is the most efficient for doing that, right?
records.en_auxiliary: And...this shape is the most efficient for doing that, right?
records.en: And...this shape is the most efficient for doing that, right?

records.jp: 間違ってはない。雑だけど
records.en_original: Quite an oversimplification, but it's not wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: Quite an oversimplification, but it's not wrong.
records.en: Quite an oversimplification, but it's not wrong.

records.jp: （ふふん、我ながら名推理♪）
records.en_original: (Hehehe, lucky guess!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hehehe, lucky guess!)
records.en: (Hehehe, lucky guess!)

records.jp: ごめん、聞こえなかった。<CR>羽根の音がおっきくて
records.en_original: Sorry, I couldn't hear you. The blades are too loud.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, I couldn't hear you. The blades are too loud.
records.en: Sorry, I couldn't hear you.<CR>The blades are too loud.

records.jp: だから……
records.en_original: I said...
records.en_auxiliary: I said...
records.en: I said...

records.jp: えっ……ちょ……
records.en_original: Uh... Wha...
records.en_auxiliary: Uh... Wha...
records.en: Uh... Wha...

records.jp: ……ってこと。<CR>これでわかった？
records.en_original: ...and that's it. Do you get it now?
records.en_auxiliary: ...and that's it. Do you get it now?
records.en: ...and that's it.<CR>Do you get it now?

records.jp: 伶那さんてば大胆……
records.en_original: You're so bold, Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: You're so bold, Rena...
records.en: You're so bold, Rena-san...

records.jp: 何？
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: いや、なんでもないです……
records.en_original: Oh, nothing...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, nothing...
records.en: Oh, nothing...

records.jp: こういうのウザい？
records.en_original: Am I annoying you?
records.en_auxiliary: Am I annoying you?
records.en: Am I annoying you?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 解説しちゃうの
records.en_original: You know, with my long explanations.
records.en_auxiliary: You know, with my long explanations.
records.en: You know, with my long explanations.

records.jp: ううん。いつも面白いなと思って聞いてる
records.en_original: No way. They're always really interesing.
records.en_auxiliary: No way. They're always really interesing.
records.en: No way. They're always really interesing.

records.jp: 本当に？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: うん。それにさ、伶那さんがそういう知識を<CR>応用してくれるから、私たちが楽に生活できてるわけで
records.en_original: Yeah. And besides, it's thanks to your knowledge that we can live comfortably like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. And besides, it's thanks to your knowledge that we can live comfortably like this.
records.en: Yeah. And because you put that knowledge to<CR>use, Rena-san, the rest of us can live comfortably.

records.jp: 恩しかないのに、ウザいなんて思わないよ
records.en_original: So I don't think you're annoying at all. Really, I should be thanking you.
records.en_auxiliary: So I don't think you're annoying at all. Really, I should be thanking you.
records.en: So I don't think you're annoying at all. Really, I should be thanking you.

records.jp: その精神を勉強の時も見せてほしい
records.en_original: If only that's how you felt about my lessons.
records.en_auxiliary: If only that's how you felt about my lessons.
records.en: If only that's how you felt about my lessons.

records.jp: いやぁ、それとこれは別だよー
records.en_original: Ehh, that's a different story...
records.en_auxiliary: Ehh, that's a different story...
records.en: Ehh, that's a different story...

records.jp: 正直難しい時もある。けど……
records.en_original: To be honest, they're a little difficult to follow sometimes. But...
records.en_auxiliary: To be honest, they're a little difficult to follow sometimes. But...
records.en: Honestly, sometimes your explanations are difficult. But...

records.jp: ないと寂しいかな。<CR>特別感があるから
records.en_original: I'd be sad without your explanations. They're kinda special.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd be sad without your explanations. They're kinda special.
records.en: I think I would miss them if they stopped.<CR>They feel special.

records.jp: どういうこと？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: 伶那さん、みんなの前ではこういう話しないよね
records.en_original: You don't talk about these things in front of others, do you, Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't talk about these things in front of others, do you, Rena?
records.en: You don't talk about these things in front of others, do you, Rena-san?

records.jp: でも私には余談って感じで結構喋ってくれる
records.en_original: But with me, it seems like you're comfortable rambling on about something.
records.en_auxiliary: But with me, it seems like you're comfortable rambling on about something.
records.en: But with me, you talk quite a lot, almost as an aside.

records.jp: そう思うと、ありがたいっていうか<CR>変に気を遣われてないんだなっていうか……
records.en_original: I'm glad that you don't feel like you need to hold back...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad that you don't feel like you need to hold back...
records.en: When I think about it that way, I'm grateful...<CR>or maybe just glad you don't feel like you have to hold back around me.

records.jp: もう喋んない

records.en_auxiliary: I'll never speak again.
records.en: I'll never speak again.

records.jp: え～、もっと聞かせてよ～

records.en_auxiliary: Noooo! Tell me more!
records.en: Noooo! Tell me more!
